title: Wee Pines Mini Golf
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Nestled amidst the picturesque town of Pinehurst, North Carolina, lies a gem of family entertainment: Wee Pines Mini Golf. This vibrant mini-golf haven offers an immersive experience for all ages, boasting two 18-hole, creatively designed courses that wind through lush greenery, charming water features, and whimsical obstacles. One course is handicapped accessible!
